Summary: Deuteronomy 6:4 declares the Shema's foundation: 'Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD.' The oneness of God is the ground of the whole-person love that follows.
Commandment: Know that the LORD our God is one LORD.
Application: Jesus quotes this as the first and greatest commandment's ground, joining it to love of neighbour as the summary of the whole Law and the Prophets (Mark 12:29-31).
Purpose: The Shema's demand (Deuteronomy 6:4-5): whole-person love answering the one LORD; Jesus calls it the first and greatest commandment.
